evals.prompt: Нужно завести новый сервис billing-api под проектом payments на sonar-prod. Что мне для этого нужно сделать, с чего начать?
evals.expected_output: Explains the two-step GitLab-only contract (create k8s-projects/payments subgroup with member roles, add a repo with a deploy/overlays/ directory at its root — base/ plus one overlay per environment, copied from examples/kustomize-project), that no changes to the infra repo are needed, and that onboarding is picked up automatically on a ~3 minute scan. Must get the generated objects right: an AppProject, Vault access, and TWO Argo CD Applications per repo (payments-<repo>-test and payments-<repo>-prod), all landing in a single namespace named payments — not one namespace per repo or per environment. Bonus for naming the overlay contract (nameSuffix per environment, includeSelectors on the environment label). Shows verification via argocd_exec (app list / app get / proj get). Should not suggest manually applying kubectl manifests or copying examples/*.yaml into the infra repo.

evals.prompt: I just created the GitLab subgroup k8s-projects/search and pushed a deploy repo with a deploy/ folder at the root, but I don't see anything show up in Argo CD yet. Is that expected or did I mess something up?
evals.expected_output: Should catch that a flat deploy/ folder is the likely bug, not just slowness: the marker the platform filters on is deploy/overlays/ specifically, and a repo without it is never picked up. Also explains the ~3 minute discovery scan so a short wait is normal, gives argocd_exec commands to check (app list -o json, app get, proj get), notes that a correctly onboarded repo yields TWO apps (-test and -prod), and lists other real causes (repo not directly under the k8s-projects/search subgroup). Should not tell the user to manually apply an Application or AppProject manifest themselves.
